subject: CS363
filterSummary: Selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering key concurrency topics. For English, choices were driven by exceptional clarity and high peer validation (views), such as Jacob Sorber for Semaphores and Gate Smashers for Race Conditions. For Arabic, selections like Mustafa S. Aljumaily's videos were chosen for their high relevance and strong viewership within the available pool. All topics were covered in both languages with no gaps.
